title: vlm
description: Documentation for the nnsight Python library

segments.html: vlm

A vision-language name over TransformersModel (deprecated).

TransformersModel generates through the model and returns token ids. A vision-language model is the same story with images alongside the text, so prefer TransformersModel(repo_id, task="image-text-to-text") directly. VisionLanguageModel is kept for backwards compatibility — all it does is pin the task and warn on construction; input handling (a prompt with images=, or a processor encoding you built yourself) is the base class's.

.. code-block:: python

segments.code:
from nnsight import VisionLanguageModel

model = VisionLanguageModel("llava-hf/llava-1.5-7b-hf", dispatch=True)
with model.generate(text=prompt, images=[img], max_new_tokens=20) as tracer:
    ids = tracer.result.save()
print(model.tokenizer.batch_decode(ids))

segments.html: The image inputs go by keyword (images=, text=) — what the task's processor takes.

Bases: LanguageModel

Deprecated: a TransformersModel pinned to the image-text-to-text task.

Use TransformersModel(repo_id, task="image-text-to-text") instead. Its generate returns the generated token ids from a prompt plus images given by keyword (text=, images=), the task's processor turning them into the model inputs a forward takes; everything else — trace, scan — is inherited.
